notes.title: Beta branch updated to 2.2.0-beta
notes.content:
This update includes some UI changes based on feedback from players.

 - Shields and power attacks can now be deactivated by simply activating the item again (clicking on it or pressing the hotkey) instead of having to hold control while doing that.
 - The ordering of the action buttons on item description dialogs has changed so the first button in the list will hopefully be the one that is most commonly used.  The order is now: [ Pick up, Equip, Use, Move to backpack, Drop, Deactivate ]
 - When targeting with a ranged weapon, monsters will always come before inanimate objects in the target list.

notes.title: Beta branch updated to 2.1.0-beta
notes.content:
Bug fixes:

 - If you are killed by rotted potions or blood magic, the correct 'killed by' name is shown in the high scores list.
 - Ushatars now only ever hit once per turn. Previously they would hit 3 times if they had nowhere to move to after attacking.

UI updates:

 - inanimate objects (crates/weapon racks/etc) are now targetable with TAB during combat.

Gameplay updates
 - Putrid branch damage ranged damage reduced to 0.
 - Removed damage penalty on magic items.

notes.title: Beta branch updated to 2.0.1-beta
notes.content:
Bug fixes:

 - savage strikes bonus no longer gets applied to off-hand melee weapons
 - riposte no longer triggers an attack from a charged off-hand melee weapon
 - fixed bug that could cause the game state to break when an enemy was killed

Misc:

 - If there is a fatal error a popup will be shown with some info about the error. Previously fatal errors were not handled properly and the game would continue to run but in a broken state.

notes.title: v1.2.0 now live - Leveling system improvements
notes.content:
Version 1.2.0 is now live. This update is intended to improve the levelling system, making it a bit fairer and less RNG dependent. This was the most common complaint in reviews so hopefully this will make a big difference :)

[list]
[*]Changed number of talents you can pick from when you level up to 3. 
[*]Removed the "Explosive" talent. I don't think anyone ever picks it. 
[*]The "Telefrag" talent is only offered if you are holding a weapon with the "displacement" trait when you open the talents window to level up. 
[*]The "Fire Resistance" talent is only offered if you are holding a weapon with the "burning" trait when you open the talents window to level up. 
[*]The "Polymastery" talent is only offered if you are holding a weapon with the "polymorph" trait when you open the talents window to level up. 
[*]The "Sure footed" talent now makes you immune to being displaced by enemies as well as immune to knock back. 
[*]Monster immunities are now shown in their description
[*]Rolled back the version of node-webkit used for Windows.
[/list]

Levelling up should now be a more pleasant experience. Stopping the magic weapon specific talents from showing up all of the time means they will only appear when they are actually a viable choice for you. Removing explosive, buffing sure footed and letting you pick from 3 talents each level instead of 2 should give you more freedom to develop your character, and each level up will only present viable talents to choose from. 

I rolled back node-webkit because I noticed that the game was performing worse in windows since the last node-webkit update. Now it's back to 60 FPS on my potato! Yay!

notes.title: 1.2.0 beta now available
notes.content:
v1.2.0 is up on the beta branch now. It's a small update with the following changes:

- When you level up you can now pick from 4 talents instead of 2.
- Monsters immunities are now shown in their descriptions (e.g. immune to bleed, terror, etc).

These are only small changes but hopefully they will have a big impact on the gameplay and give you much more control over how your character develops. Please try it out!

To opt-in to the beta you will need to follow these steps:

1. Right click on the "The Depths of Tolagal" in your game library
2. Click on "Properties"
3. Open the "betas" tab
4. Enter "tolagalbetabranch" in to the text box and click on "Check code"
5. Use the drop down menu to select the beta branch
6. Wait for the game to update and then launch!
7. You should see "The Depths of Tolagal 1.2.0" in the window title.

- Monsters immunities are now shown in their descriptions (e.g. immune to bleed, terror, etc).

notes.title: v1.1.0 update - adds basic achievements
notes.content:
Not such a huge update - it just adds some achievements which are all based on how far you have progressed in normal mode. In the future I'm planning to add more hidden achievements as well as some for infinite mode.

Most of the work was behind the scenes stuff to integrate the game with the Steam API, but I also fixed a bug!

- The Ashdurbuk's health bar will no longer cover his face!

Cheers!
